quests.title: Royinjan's Chapter: Yoni

dialogue.t: Look at the plants here. What's inside the cave wouldn't happen to be...
*sob* It's Marana. Please protect Ararycan, Nara {NICKNAME}.
We will protect you! No need to be afraid of Marana, Ararycan.
If Amadhiah is right, {NICKNAME}, the fragment of the Amiti Device should be inside.

quests.description: You have located the fragments with the help of Amadhiah and Royinjan. One of them lies in a cavern deep within Devantaka Mountain…
